name: Anaheim Public Library Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteer at an Anaheim library branch. Some branches ask for 2 hours a week. You can also work online on a teen blog, a teen podcast or book catalog translation.
who_can_apply: Teens who are at least 14 years old and in high school.
duration: At least 2 hours a week at Central Library and Canyon Hills
deadline_text: Dates depend on the branch. East Anaheim, Haskett, Heritage Center, Ponderosa and Sunkist take applications year-round. Central Library takes them at the start of summer, fall and spring. Canyon Hills takes them in September, January and May, for summer work. Euclid takes them during the spring semester, for summer work.
how_to_apply: Pick a branch on the program page. Contact the coordinator listed for that branch. Each branch has its own contact and its own rules.
notes: An accepted application does not promise hours. Hours are given out as needed. The library does not give court-ordered service hours. The Mobile Library (Bookmobile and STEAM Van) takes summer applications in April and needs volunteers 2 to 6 p.m. on at least one Monday to Thursday. The Teen Podcast takes applications at the start of fall.
